runs.details: Installed the pinned lockfile in a fresh checkout with no existing workspace build output.

Built the web bundle and workspace, passed 178 focused unit checks across 27 files, and passed every shared Chromium scenario: 85 passed, none skipped. Includes all 15 W03 cases. BFB_CAPTURE_W03_EVIDENCE=1 retained bounded synthetic screenshots and the UI report; an isolated disposable fixture port was selected.

Passed pinned tools/lockfile, formatting, lint, typecheck, protocol/provider drift, 3130 TypeScript tests across 157 files, headers, documentation, roadmap, Go tidy/vet/tests and Swift build/16 native tests. GOFLAGS=-p=1 limited package build concurrency; no platform check was skipped.

Passed before acceptance and after verification. Newly generated W03 captures were moved to this evidence directory and only the browser-generated G01 historical counter was restored; implementation and prior certificates remained unchanged.
